verdict.rationale: A government immigration service could plausibly document authorized representatives or designees acting for a company, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a failed TLS probe of robots.txt. Nothing was fetched, so there is no evidence of a documented third-party rail.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
